definitions.explanation: In a relaxed manner without hurrying or worrying. Taking one's time.

notes:
のんびり describes a leisurely, relaxed state or pace.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: のんびりする

COMMON PATTERNS:
- のんびり + verb (leisurely ~)
- のんびりする (to relax, take it easy)
- のんびりした + noun (leisurely, easygoing)
- のんびり⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ (spend time leisurely)
- のんびり⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (live a relaxed life)
- のんびりした⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (relaxed atmosphere)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧: slowly, taking time
- のんびり: leisurely, carefree (emphasizes relaxed state)
